newsitem.title: SWEDEN: H&M to open first Finnish outlet in August.
newsitem.headline: H&M to open first Finnish outlet in August.

text.p: Swedish clothing chain Hennes & Mauritz (H&M) said on Tuesday it would open its first outlet in Helsinki, Finland, in August.
During the autumn, H&M would also open stores in the Finnish cities of Lahtis, Vasa, Tammerfors and a second outlet in Helsinki, it said in a statement.
The company originally announced its Finnish plans last January but did not at the time give opening dates.
H&M expects to employ about 200 persons in Finland within the next six months and said that it aimed to open more shops there in future.
"Of course the aim is to open more H&M outlets in Finland," the president of H&M, Stefan Persson said.
